noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

urlPathPrefix.description: The Url path prefix used to identify the request as one that needs to be proxied to the ExternalService

errorPageUrl.description:
Url for static error page content to proxy a user to, if the service is not running.
If null, then generic http error will be thrown.

keepPrefix.description:
If true, the proxied request will keep the urlPathPrefix, i.e. a request to https://c3server/proxy/foo/bar
will be proxied as https://proxyserver/proxy/foo/bar. By default it will not be kept, i.e
https://proxyserver/foo/bar

contextPutPath.description:
This annotation indicates that the {@link ExternalServiceContext} will be sent to the ExternalService using a PUT
http request before the actual proxied request is sent. The contextPath will be appended to the
{@link ExternalService} endPoint.

contextPutAuth.description:
This annotation defines the value of the http 'Authorization' header value to be used in the PUT request to
pass the {@link ExternalServiceContext} to the {@link ExternalService}. It is only used if the
{@link Ann.ExternalService.contextPutPath} is defined.

webSocketProxy.description:
If the {@link ExternalService} uses WebSocket protocol, set this annotation to 'true' to proxy the WebSocket
connection.

autoStartOnAccess.description: Auto-start the service if it's not running when a authenticated request is proxied

title: This annotations affect how an ExternalService is configured.
name: Ann.ExternalService
